notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png

Hello Midgardians!

ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree, the upcoming title from our friends at Untold Tales and Wildboy Studios, launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

A TASTE OF THE TUNES

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented James Shuar also know in the electronica scene as Luminist, as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow (The Outer Wilds). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

We put out a patch to add a few tweaks and fixes based on some rare bugs we saw a few people running into. Namely:

- Added new Language, Japanese!

- Fixed autosave system that could softlock the game.
- Fixed new reset chapter option.
- Fixed new return to last checkpoint option.
- Fixed a bug that didn't let the kid interact with the world
- Fixed several visual bugs regarding the pause menu.
- Fixed a bug that could lock the game when pausing in specific states.
- Fixed a bug where multiple fake keys could randomly appear in the HUD.

Thanks!

- Team Studio Voyager

notes.title: Meet Leo and Lise!
notes.content:
Last time, we introduced you to The Kid and Everett, aka the protagonist and his mentor. 

Today we dive into the backgrounds of the game's antagonist, Leo, and her right-hand woman, Lise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041180/7973be887d0661af2f703276460749cc49762096.png

Strong and Serious
She is a former friend of Everett and the current leader of the ZENITH, the team that's out to capture Everett, and whose charged with maintaining order in the multiverse.  

With the increasing appearance of interferences (objects which phase between universes), her work became more of a surveillance operation, rather than an investigation into Everett's whereabouts. 

Everett's reappearance throws a spanner in her works. Upon seeing his irresponsible universe traversal and his obsession with his old assistant's supposed investigation, she decided capturing him would once again become her priority, in order to save him from insanity. 

She takes good care of her team and those around her and tries to maintain her composure at all times. This, unfortunately, leads to her collapsing from time to time. She takes those close to her as her responsibility and insists on Everett's capture more out of concern than duty. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041180/4b47ad5ffe467c0dab8bc876e7ea032d4d9d1c8e.png

Bad but Good?
Lise is good-natured, nervous, and has low self-esteem. She's always being overshadowed due to her shyness.

She is Leo's right-hand woman and Nash's rival, even if she has the best of intentions.  She adopted a great admiration for Nash's confidence that led her to form a toxic friendship with him, even though he couldn't see her as anything other than the competition. 

Although Lise does not believe in herself, Leo knows how capable she is and that is why she almost always has her by his side. As a result, she is constantly insulted by a jealous Nash, who is irritated by her not daring to impose herself and for her insisting on seeing his good side, however difficult he may be.  She gets along well with the rest of the team and is the one who likes the leading duo the most. 

She doesn't care so much about capturing the lead duo as much as simply being helpful, to Leo and the team. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stay with us as we'll be uncovering more characters soon.

- Team Untold Tales

notes.title: Join us as we spotlight the characters of What Lies in the Multiverse
notes.content:
We are so excited to introduce you to the characters of What Lies in the Multiverse. 
Everyone at Untold Tales has completely fallen in love with them and can't wait for you to meet them when the game launches in early 2022. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041180/e76a48671af33e4b751be22d9e066e69baf61255.png
The Protagonist of Our Story 
A gifted and socially awkward boy, who generated a detachment from his world due to social isolation (something we can all relate to post 2020 huh?). 
Uninterested in hanging out with friends, he became obsessed with his studies on parallel universes, excited about the idea of more interesting worlds than his own. 

After a series of events leads to him meeting Everett, The Kid becomes obsessed with the idea of accompanying the scientist on his universe crossing adventures and manages to blag himself the role of Everett's new assistant. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041180/8926dc78542f031134b3f4260fa9e547440ad01e.png
Co-star of the Story 
A mysterious, quirky, and sarcastic old man with the ability to travel across worlds. He's from a different universe than The Kid. 
Being a leading scientist within his own world, he became seriously paranoid after discovering something peculiar in another universe, which would change his perception of life and the multiverse forever. 

Destroyed by the death of his previous assistant, he decided to go looking for answers, believing that the chaos of the multiverse had been to blame for the accident that ended the life of his friend. 
He is irresponsible and does not care about the consequences of his actions. He prioritizes his search for answers above all else and is not afraid of how that might affect the multiverse nor the beings that exist within it.

Upon accidentally meeting The Kid, despite being initially hesitant, he soon warms to him and allows him to become his new assistant, and so they begin their adventure together.

---

Stay with us as we'll be uncovering more characters soon.
